text:
Both issues are fixed and verified:

1. **Boundary bug**: `now - last <= self.window` → `now - last < self.window`. An event exactly one window after the previous sighting is now reported as new, matching the documented half-open window semantics (`seen("job-1", 10)` with `Deduper(10)` now returns `False`).
2. **Memory growth**: added `_expire(now)`, called at the start of each `seen`, which drops keys whose window has ended. After 200,000 distinct keys, only ~10 entries (the still-open windows) remain in memory instead of everything ever seen.

All 3 tests pass, plus my boundary and memory sanity checks.
